title.narrative: Healthy and Sustainable Agriculture Resilient to Climate Change Phase Out

description.narrative: The project is subject to phase out. Announced in July 2025, the phase out period is ending on March 31st 2026. The objective of the phase out period is to supportADAD Malore in securinglong-term availability of the services and viability of the organisation. It supports their resource mobilization efforts to sustain service delivery, facilitates the potential transfer of services to another PO or emerging organisation, and reinforces continuity and local ownership throughout the transition. Based on the capacity building activities introduced during the previous Sida CIVSAM programme, ADAD Malore were capacitated to introduce a new services to its members, particularly in the area of climate adaptation in agriculture and application of SALM measures. This will be subject to further capacity development of ADAD Malore staff and in-practice training to its members. Efforts will be undertaken to ensure that ADAD Malore is adequately prepared and continues to provide services that enable its members to successfully implement contract farming. The project will also increasethe awareness of local communities about protective measures against natural disasters, particularly in the region of Korçë and Peshkopi.
